lines.trans: How confident are you feeling about this project?
Thirty million adult video fans nationwide are waiting, so I simply have to answer them.

words.reading: ゼンコクサンゼンマン

lines.trans: It will be a high-voltage work that feels just like real-life nonfiction.
Please tell us why you decided to shoot a comeback work at this exact moment.
We had been storing up our energy.
Because the era when people can watch adult videos twenty-four hours a day is right around the corner.
This whole world is a game of making people happy.

words.gloss: game of making each other happy

lines.trans: Then Ms. Kuroki, please share your enthusiasm for the new film.
The response to our new film has been truly tremendous.
I jumped the gun announcing it—was it trouble for you?

words.gram: Polite past form of auxiliary しまう, showing an unintentional reaction.
Conjunction trailing off to soften hesitation.

lines.trans: I'm grateful you stirred up so much buzz. I feel fired up for the first time in ages.

words.gloss: hot topic, talk of the town

words.gram: Plain imperative of くれる (give/do for me).
